settings.text: In this section you will find quick and easy answers to all your questions about our products, ordering processes, payment options and delivery terms. This information should help you to gain a better understanding of our offers and simplify your experience with us. If you have any further questions, please do not hesitate to contact our customer service team.

settings.heading: What types of products does artclub offer?
settings.row_content: Artclub offers originals, prints & merchandise. Each edition differs in terms of limitation, signature and format.

settings.heading: Can I have my work customised?
settings.row_content: No, not yet. However, this is planned for the future

settings.heading: How can I have my work framed?
settings.row_content: artclub does not currently offer a framing service. However, it is possible to buy all prints with a frame. If you would like to have an original framed, please send us an email to sk@artclub.wtf and we will organise this for you.

settings.heading: How much does an artclub work cost?
settings.row_content: Prices vary depending on the edition and additional options. Originals start at 999€ & PRINTS start from under 109€.

settings.heading: Do I have to have a customer account to be able to order?
settings.row_content: No, ordering as a guest is possible.

settings.heading: Which payment methods are accepted?
settings.row_content: Artclub accepts direct debit, PayPal, credit card (Master Card, VISA), Klarna.

settings.heading: How secure is my online payment?
settings.row_content: The online order is secured by SSL encryption.

settings.heading: How can I redeem a voucher?
settings.row_content: Voucher codes can be redeemed during the order process.

settings.heading: How much does shipping cost?
settings.row_content: The shipping costs vary depending on the size of the work and the shipping option selected.

settings.heading: How long does delivery take?
settings.row_content: The delivery time is usually around 10 days, but can vary.

settings.heading: What delivery options are available?
settings.row_content: Artclub offers standard shipping and a premium delivery service.

settings.heading: Can I arrange a delivery date?
settings.row_content: This must be arranged directly with the shipping service provider. If you have any questions about this, simply contact sk@artclub.wtf

settings.heading: Can I track my delivery?
settings.row_content: Yes, a tracking number will be provided after dispatch.
